Package au.csiro.pathling.terminology.local.index

Class ConceptDictionary

java.lang.Object
au.csiro.pathling.terminology.local.index.ConceptDictionary
public final class ConceptDictionary extends Object
The concept dictionary for one code system version: the mapping between concept codes and the dense integer identifiers that address the runtime bitmaps, plus each concept's status, display, and defining metadata. It is loaded first and gates every other index.
Author:
John Grimes
